messages:
Taylor: Heads up — CloverTech sent a SIG/CAIQ plus a short vendor security spreadsheet. They want the completed SIG + a short explanation of our embedding handling for legal. Deadline Friday COB. Link: https://files.redwood.com/clovertech/clover_sig_2026.zip

Taylor: Sales needs a one-liner: do we store embeddings in analytics or for feature telemetry?

Ravi: I can own this. @security-requests-bot open a ticket and cc privacy/legal.

security-requests-bot: Ticket created: RINF-2026-789. Priority: P2. Assignee: Ravi. Due: 2026-05-01.

Ravi: Quick operational note for sales — are they testing on Hosted or Dedicated for the POC? That determines what we can promise.

Taylor: Starting Hosted for rapid demo; may request Dedicated later. They specifically asked "no embeddings in analytics or 3rd-party telemetry sinks."

Elena: Our Hosted stance: embeddings are computed transiently and not persisted to analytics or long-term storage. We may capture non-content telemetry (latency, request size, error codes) for observability. If they need customer-controlled, auditable storage, recommend Dedicated/Private.

Marta: Draft answer for the questionnaire:
"Redwood processes requests and computes embeddings transiently during the request lifecycle. We do not persist raw embeddings to analytics platforms, third-party telemetry, or long-term storage for Hosted customers. Non-content operational telemetry (e.g., latency, token counts) may be collected for service health. For requirements needing auditable, customer-controlled persistence of embeddings, we recommend Dedicated or Private deployments where storage policies can be configured and managed by the customer or under a contractual addendum."

Ravi: Add legal caveat: "Except where retention is required by law or pursuant to a signed agreement." Also add: POC data deletion policy — delete on request or after 30 days of inactivity unless otherwise agreed.

Elena: I'll map this to the SIG control IDs for data handling and upload the completed CAIQ fields. ETA: tomorrow morning.

Taylor: Also note that if they ask about model caching (KV cache), say we use ephemeral caches for performance; they are not used for analytics or persistent storage.

Marta: Good call — include: "Model runtime caches are ephemeral and scoped to inference instances; they are not persisted to analytics."

Ravi: I'll produce the final canned text for the sales reply including the POC deletion blurb and a note on Dedicated/Private options. If legal needs a specific addendum, I'll flag it in the ticket.

security-requests-bot: RINF-2026-789 updated: status=In Progress, watchers=[Taylor,Ravi,Elena,Marta].
